questions.stem: Which of the following statements about the use of mirrors is correct?
choices: Concave mirrors are used in vehicle headlights to produce parallel beams of light.
Convex mirrors are used in dental clinics to see enlarged images of teeth.
Plane mirrors are used in telescopes to focus light from distant stars.
Concave mirrors are used in street lamps to spread light over a wide area.
questions.solution: The correct answer is that concave mirrors are used in vehicle headlights to produce parallel beams of light. Concave mirrors can converge light rays to form a parallel beam, which is useful for headlights. Convex mirrors are used in vehicles as side-view mirrors, not in dental clinics. Plane mirrors do not focus light, and concave mirrors are not used in street lamps for this purpose.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा दर्पणों के उपयोग के बारे में कथन सही है?
choices: अवतल दर्पण कार के हेडलाइट में उपयोग किए जाते हैं ताकि प्रकाश की समानांतर किरणें बन सकें।
उत्तल दर्पण दंत चिकित्सा क्लिनिक में दांतों के बड़े चित्र देखने के लिए उपयोग किए जाते हैं।
समतल दर्पण दूर के तारों से प्रकाश को केंद्रित करने के लिए दूरबीन में उपयोग किए जाते हैं।
अवतल दर्पण चौराहों के लैंप में उपयोग किए जाते हैं ताकि प्रकाश एक विस्तृत क्षेत्र में फैल सके।
hi.solution: सही उत्तर यह है कि अवतल दर्पण कार के हेडलाइट में उपयोग किए जाते हैं ताकि प्रकाश की समानांतर किरणें बन सकें। अवतल दर्पण प्रकाश की किरणों को एकत्रित कर सकते हैं और एक समानांतर किरण बना सकते हैं, जो हेडलाइट के लिए उपयोगी है। उत्तल दर्पण वाहनों में बाहरी दृष्टि दर्पण के रूप में उपयोग किए जाते हैं, न कि दंत चिकित्सा क्लिनिक में। समतल दर्पण प्रकाश को केंद्रित नहीं करते हैं, और अवतल दर्पण इस उद्देश्य के लिए चौराहों के लैंप में उपयोग नहीं किए जाते हैं।

questions.stem: What is the function of the normal line in the law of reflection?
choices: To indicate the direction of the incident ray
To measure the angle of incidence
To show the path of the reflected ray
To represent the surface of the mirror
questions.solution: The function of the normal line in the law of reflection is to measure the angle of incidence. The normal is a line perpendicular to the mirror's surface at the point of incidence, and the angle between the normal and the incident ray is the angle of incidence. The other options incorrectly describe the role of the normal line.

questions.stem: In a reflecting telescope, what is the primary function of the main mirror?
choices: To produce a magnified image of the object
To focus and converge light rays from distant objects
To adjust the angle of incoming light
To create a virtual image for observation
questions.solution: The primary function of the main mirror in a reflecting telescope is to focus and converge light rays from distant objects. This is a key principle of concave mirrors, which are used to gather and direct light to a focal point. Other options incorrectly describe the role of the mirror or confuse it with other optical components.

questions.stem: What is the function of a convex lens?
choices: To diverge light rays
To converge light rays
To reflect light rays
To absorb light rays
questions.solution: A convex lens is designed to converge light rays because it is thicker at the center and thinner at the edges, causing the light to bend inward. The other options are incorrect because diverging is the function of a convex lens, reflecting is the function of a mirror, and absorbing is not a characteristic of a lens.

questions.stem: A convex lens is used to focus the light from a distant object. What happens to the light rays?
